hero.title: From northern Gaza, we document daily life as it is
hero.sub: A small volunteer team. Short videos about water, roads, tents and winter, as we live them.

blocks.title: We document
blocks.text: We film what we see in our own days: the road to water, the queue, the rubble. No staging, no exaggeration.

blocks.title: We verify
blocks.text: We write what we saw ourselves, and attribute what we did not see to whoever said it.

blocks.title: We respect
blocks.text: People's dignity comes before the camera. We do not exploit pain. We ask only that you know, and share.

cta.text: Start with the videos. If our voice reaches you, follow us.

meta.title: Our story | Marsa Team
meta.description: Who we are, why we document, and how we work: dignity, accuracy, sources and consent. A volunteer team from northern Gaza.

story.title: Our story
story.intro: We are friends and volunteers from northern Gaza. We started because much of what happens around us reaches the world incomplete or without context, and we wanted to tell it ourselves, calmly and with sources.

why.title: Why Marsa?
why.text: A marsa is a harbour, a place where a ship can rest. We want our work to be a calm and reliable place for information amid a lot of noise.

document.title: What we document
document.text: The details of daily life: how water reaches people, market prices and shortages, the road and the rubble. When we report what trusted bodies have announced, we name them.

honest.title: A plain word
honest.text: We are a small volunteer team, and we are currently working on licensing the team. We say so from the start because trust begins with honesty.

principles.title: Dignity
principles.text: We do not film people at their weakest to win sympathy. We focus on the situation, not on individuals.

principles.title: Accuracy
principles.text: We write exactly what we saw. What we did not see ourselves, we attribute to whoever said it.

principles.title: Sources
principles.text: Every number has a body and a date. With no source, we do not publish the number.

principles.title: Consent
principles.text: We respect anyone who does not want to appear, and take special care with children.

meta.title: What we do | Marsa Team
meta.description: Field documentation, water awareness, fact-checking, and partnerships with registered bodies. This is what Marsa Team, from northern Gaza, works on.

work.title: What we do
work.intro: Four areas, and we grow in them step by step.

areas.title: Documenting
areas.text: Short videos (about half a minute) from daily life in northern Gaza, subtitled in Arabic and English so the meaning reaches people outside Gaza.

areas.title: Water awareness
areas.text: Water is the first thing people here ask about. We film the road to it and what it costs people's lives.

areas.title: Sourcing and fact-checking
areas.text: We check every claim before posting and cite the source in the caption. If a fact changes, we correct it in public.

areas.title: Partnerships
areas.text: We look for registered organizations and partners who can guide us and work with us transparently. We do not promise what we cannot deliver.

help.text: Share one video with someone you trust, with the written source in the caption.

help.title: Introduce a partner

help.title: Correct us
help.text: Found a mistake or a better source? Tell us and we will correct it in public.

meta.title: FAQ | Marsa Team
meta.description: Who we are, licensing, support and rights: straight answers from Marsa Team.

items.a: A small volunteer team of friends from northern Gaza. We document daily life in short videos. We do not publish our members' names, to protect their safety and privacy.
We are currently working on licensing the team.
Ways to support are being arranged; we will announce them when ready. To talk about supporting us, email marsa.team1@gmail.com or write to us on any of our pages.

items.q: Do you belong to a political party or group?
items.a: No. We are a small civilian team aiming for documentation and accurate information.
All rights reserved to the team; to use our material, please contact us.

meta.title: Contact and partnerships | Marsa Team
meta.description: For partnerships, guidance or media questions, email Marsa Team at marsa.team1@gmail.com. What to expect from us and how long replies take.

contact.title: Contact and partnerships
contact.intro: Write to us at marsa.team1@gmail.com, by direct message on our pages @marsa_team, or on WhatsApp.
expect: Plain talk about our situation: we are a volunteer team looking for guidance and partnership. We are currently working on licensing the team.
Written documentation for everything we publish, with sources, shared with you on request.
No promises about scale or speed. We tell you what we can really do.
We never use your name or logo in public without your written consent.

response.title: About reply times
response.text: We are a small team, and power and internet sometimes go down on our side. We reply within 24 hours for now, and if we are late, we apologise in advance.

contact.what_to_send: In your message, tell us who you are, what kind of partnership you have in mind, and what you expect from us.
